description: This file contains test specifications for the TUI module of the openclaw project, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions related to TUI behavior, command parsing, session management, and error handling.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Determines the final text to display for the assistant, preferring finalText, then streamedText, then errorMessage.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Returns available slash commands, including gateway commands.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses a slash command string into structured command name and arguments.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the session key based on raw input, scope, current agent, and main key.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Infers the initial TUI agent ID based on configuration, current working directory, and session input.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Provides user guidance based on the reason for gateway disconnection.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a deduplication function for backspace events within a specified time window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines what action to take upon receiving a Ctrl+C, including warning, clearing input, or exiting.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks whether a stop error is ignorable during TUI shutdown.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Safely stops the TUI, ignoring certain errors.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
